title: Slim Fly: A Cost Effective Low-Diameter Network Topology
venue: Int Conf High Perform Comput Netw Storage Anal
venue_full: International Conference for High Performance Computing, Networking, Storage and Analysis
research_focus: Datacenter networking, Network topology, Energy / Carbon

problem_statement.en: High-performance computing and datacenter networks face challenges with high latency, high costs, and energy consumption due to sub-optimal network diameters in existing topologies.
problem_statement.zh: 高效能運算與資料中心網路因現有拓撲的次優網路直徑，而面臨高 latency、高成本與高能耗等挑戰。

key_innovation.en: Slim Fly, a high-performance, cost-effective network topology based on graphs that approximate the solution to the degree-diameter problem, achieving near-optimal network diameter.
key_innovation.zh: Slim Fly 是一種高效能且具成本效益的網路拓撲，以近似求解 degree-diameter 問題的圖論結構為基礎，實現接近最優的網路直徑。

baselines_compared: Torus 3D, Torus 5D, Hypercube, Fat Tree, Flattened Butterfly, Dragonfly, Random topologies (DLN), Long Hop

key_improvements.en: 25% cost and power benefit over Dragonfly, lower latency, high resiliency, and scalability to over 100K endpoints with diameter two.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於 Dragonfly，成本與功耗降低 25%；latency 更低、韌性更高；在直徑為 2 的前提下可擴展至超過 10 萬個端點。

network_topology: Slim Fly, Fat-Tree, Dragonfly, Flattened Butterfly, Torus, Hypercube, Long Hop, Random topologies
ai_task: HPC workloads, Stencil computations, Graph computations, Deep learning, Irregular matrix computations
traffic_pattern: Uniform random traffic, Bit complement, Bit reversal, Shuffle, Shift traffic, Worst-case adversarial traffic
compute_memory_hw: Black Widow 64-port routers, Mellanox 108-port Director, Mellanox IB FDR10 routers
network_hw: Mellanox IB FDR10 40Gb/s QSFP, Mellanox IB QDR 56Gb/s QSFP, Mellanox Ethernet 40Gb/s QSFP, Elpeus Ethernet 10Gb/s SFP+
routing_and_congestion_control: Minimal static routing (MIN), Valiant Random Routing (VAL), UGAL-L, UGAL-G, DFSSSP
